one_liner: Close is a CRM with a broad REST API, self-serve OAuth app registration, API keys, and an official remote MCP server; the builder needs a 14-day trial or a free secondary or dev org to test.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with self-serve app creation, refresh tokens via offline_access, and all apps get full_access scope. API keys are sent via HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password).
access_notes: No free plan. A 14-day free trial with no credit card is available. API access starts on the Solo plan. Existing Close users can create a free secondary org. Non-users can request a free Dev org by email. OAuth apps keep working after a subscription lapses.
blocker_notes: Builder needs a trial, a secondary org or a free Dev org (request by email). A self-serve trial plus the free dev org path is enough to build and test.

evidence.quote: All OAuth applications are granted the `all.full_access offline_access` scopes, providing the same level of access as API keys.
The Authorization Code can be exchanged for an Access Token by performing a POST request with form-encoded parameters to `https://api.close.com/oauth2/token/`
API keys use [HTTP Basic client side authentication]
Start your free 14-day trial—no credit card required.
Dev organizations work identically to standard Close organizations but have no subscription fees.
Close provides a REST API for building custom integrations, connecting your applications, and automating sales processes.
The MCP server URL is `https://mcp.close.com/mcp` and has “HTTP Streamable” and “OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)” support.
